hints: Pass the position as int *i and advance it through the string; every recursive call continues exactly where the previous one stopped.
The key design choice: if the next non-space character is not '(', return NULL WITHOUT moving *i. That single rule makes '(2)' (bare leaf) and '(2()())' (explicit empties) parse identically.
Numbers can be multi-digit: value = value * 10 + (s[*i] - '0') while isdigit. Reading one character as the value is the classic bug - it passes on single-digit trees only.
